summary.en: Surrounds and protects the brain.

detail.en: The skull forms a hard case around the brain. Many of its bones meet at seams called sutures, which allow little movement. Here the skull bones are selected together [S30].
detail.zh: 颅骨围成坚硬的骨性外壳，保护脑。许多颅骨以骨缝相接，活动很小。模型把这些骨合为一组，方便点选 [S30]。

summary.en: Carries the lower teeth and moves at the jaw.
summary.zh: 承托下牙，并在颌关节活动。

detail.en: The mandible is the lower jaw bone and holds the lower teeth. It moves against the skull when you open your mouth or chew. Unlike most skull bones, it can move freely at its joints [S30].
detail.zh: 下颌骨承托下排牙齿。张嘴和咀嚼时，它相对颅骨活动。与大多数颅骨不同，下颌骨能在两侧的关节处明显活动 [S30]。

summary.en: Supports the head above the trunk.

detail.en: The neck bones support the head and surround the upper part of the spinal cord. Small movements between neighbouring bones add up when you turn or nod your head. The neck bones form one selectable group here [S30].
detail.zh: 颈椎支撑头部，并围护颈部的脊髓。相邻椎骨之间的小幅活动合起来，让头能转动和点动。模型把颈椎合为一组 [S30]。

summary.en: Supports the ribs along the back.

detail.en: These back bones support the chest and meet the ribs. Together with the ribs and sternum, they form the rib cage around the heart and lungs. The chest vertebrae are one selectable group here [S30].
detail.zh: 胸椎位于背部，与肋骨相接。它们和肋骨、胸骨共同构成胸廓，围护心肺。模型把胸椎合为一个可选组 [S30]。

summary.en: Transfers trunk load towards the pelvis.

detail.en: The lower-back bones carry weight from the upper body towards the pelvis. Their thick bodies help support this load, while their connections allow some bending. These vertebrae are grouped for selection [S30].
detail.zh: 腰椎把上半身的重量传向骨盆。它们粗厚的椎体帮助承重，椎骨之间的连接也允许一定程度的弯曲。模型把腰椎合为一组 [S30]。

summary.en: Links the spine with the pelvic ring.

detail.en: The sacrum is the broad bone at the back of the pelvis. It links the spine to the two hip bones and passes body weight into the pelvic ring. In an adult, it is formed from fused vertebrae [S30].
detail.zh: 骶骨是骨盆后方较宽的骨。它把脊柱与两侧髋骨连接起来，把身体重量传入骨盆环。成人的骶骨由几块椎骨融合而成 [S30]。

summary.en: Forms the small lower end of the spine.
summary.zh: 构成脊柱下端的小骨段。

detail.en: The coccyx is the small tail end of the spine below the sacrum. Muscles and ligaments attach around it. Its small size does not mean it is separate from the rest of the skeleton [S30].
detail.zh: 尾骨位于骶骨下方，是脊柱最下端的小骨段。周围有肌肉和韧带附着。虽然体积小，它仍是骨架的一部分 [S30]。

summary.en: Supports the front of the ribcage.

detail.en: The sternum is the flat bone down the front of the chest. Ribs connect towards it through flexible costal cartilage, helping form the protective rib cage. Its upper, middle and small lower sections are selected together here [S30].
detail.zh: 胸骨位于胸前正中，是一块扁骨。肋骨经有弹性的肋软骨与它相连，共同形成保护心肺的胸廓。模型把胸骨的上、中、下三部分合为一件 [S30]。

summary.en: Curve around the heart and lungs.
summary.zh: 弯绕在心脏和肺的外侧。

detail.en: The ribs curve from the back towards the front of the chest, enclosing the heart and lungs. A usual rib cage has twelve pairs: seven pairs connect directly to the sternum through cartilage, three join indirectly, and two have free front ends. Each side is one selectable group here [S30].
detail.zh: 肋骨从背部向胸前弯曲，围护心肺。通常有十二对：七对经各自的软骨连向胸骨，三对间接相连，最下两对的前端游离。模型把每侧肋骨与肋软骨合为一组 [S30]。

summary.en: Curve around the heart and lungs.
summary.zh: 弯绕在心脏和肺的外侧。

detail.en: The ribs curve from the back towards the front of the chest, enclosing the heart and lungs. A usual rib cage has twelve pairs: seven pairs connect directly to the sternum through cartilage, three join indirectly, and two have free front ends. Each side is one selectable group here [S30].
detail.zh: 肋骨从背部向胸前弯曲，围护心肺。通常有十二对：七对经各自的软骨连向胸骨，三对间接相连，最下两对的前端游离。模型把每侧肋骨与肋软骨合为一组 [S30]。

summary.en: Holds the shoulder away from the chest.

detail.en: The clavicle runs between the sternum and the shoulder blade. It helps hold the shoulder out from the chest so the arm has room to move. You can follow its curved shape across the top of the rib cage [S30].
detail.zh: 锁骨连接胸骨与肩胛骨。它把肩部撑在胸廓外侧，为手臂活动留出空间。沿着胸廓上方，可以看到它弯曲的走向 [S30]。

summary.en: Holds the shoulder away from the chest.

detail.en: The clavicle runs between the sternum and the shoulder blade. It helps hold the shoulder out from the chest so the arm has room to move. You can follow its curved shape across the top of the rib cage [S30].
detail.zh: 锁骨连接胸骨与肩胛骨。它把肩部撑在胸廓外侧，为手臂活动留出空间。沿着胸廓上方，可以看到它弯曲的走向 [S30]。

summary.en: Provides the socket for the upper arm.

detail.en: The scapula is the flat shoulder blade on the back of the chest. Its shallow socket meets the rounded head of the upper arm bone. Many muscles attach to it and help move both the shoulder blade and the arm [S30].
detail.zh: 肩胛骨是胸背部的扁骨。它外侧较浅的关节窝与肱骨的圆头相接。许多肌肉附着在这里，帮助肩胛骨和手臂活动 [S30]。

summary.en: Provides the socket for the upper arm.

detail.en: The scapula is the flat shoulder blade on the back of the chest. Its shallow socket meets the rounded head of the upper arm bone. Many muscles attach to it and help move both the shoulder blade and the arm [S30].
detail.zh: 肩胛骨是胸背部的扁骨。它外侧较浅的关节窝与肱骨的圆头相接。许多肌肉附着在这里，帮助肩胛骨和手臂活动 [S30]。

summary.en: Acts as the upper arm’s bony lever.

detail.en: The humerus is the long bone of the upper arm. Its rounded head meets the shoulder blade, while its lower end helps form the elbow. Muscles pull on it to move the arm [S30].
detail.zh: 肱骨是上臂的长骨。上端圆形的骨头与肩胛骨相接，下端参与构成肘关节。肌肉拉动肱骨，使上臂活动 [S30]。

summary.en: Acts as the upper arm’s bony lever.

detail.en: The humerus is the long bone of the upper arm. Its rounded head meets the shoulder blade, while its lower end helps form the elbow. Muscles pull on it to move the arm [S30].
detail.zh: 肱骨是上臂的长骨。上端圆形的骨头与肩胛骨相接，下端参与构成肘关节。肌肉拉动肱骨，使上臂活动 [S30]。

summary.en: Turns with the hand around the ulna.

detail.en: The radius is the forearm bone on the thumb side when the palm faces forwards. It turns relative to the ulna as you turn your palm up or down. The biceps tendon attaches to it and helps bend the elbow [S30, S32].
detail.zh: 手掌朝前时，桡骨位于前臂靠拇指的一侧。翻转手掌时，桡骨相对尺骨转动。肱二头肌的肌腱附着在桡骨上，帮助屈肘 [S30, S32]。

summary.en: Turns with the hand around the ulna.

detail.en: The radius is the forearm bone on the thumb side when the palm faces forwards. It turns relative to the ulna as you turn your palm up or down. The biceps tendon attaches to it and helps bend the elbow [S30, S32].
detail.zh: 手掌朝前时，桡骨位于前臂靠拇指的一侧。翻转手掌时，桡骨相对尺骨转动。肱二头肌的肌腱附着在桡骨上，帮助屈肘 [S30, S32]。

summary.en: Forms the main hinge at the elbow.
summary.zh: 构成肘部主要的铰链结构。

detail.en: The ulna is the forearm bone on the little-finger side when the palm faces forwards. Its upper end fits around the humerus to form the main elbow hinge. The triceps pulls on the bony point at its upper end to straighten the elbow [S30, S33].
detail.zh: 手掌朝前时，尺骨位于前臂靠小指的一侧。它的上端与肱骨相接，构成肘部主要的铰链。肱三头肌拉动尺骨上端的鹰嘴，使肘伸直 [S30, S33]。

summary.en: Forms the main hinge at the elbow.
summary.zh: 构成肘部主要的铰链结构。

detail.en: The ulna is the forearm bone on the little-finger side when the palm faces forwards. Its upper end fits around the humerus to form the main elbow hinge. The triceps pulls on the bony point at its upper end to straighten the elbow [S30, S33].
detail.zh: 手掌朝前时，尺骨位于前臂靠小指的一侧。它的上端与肱骨相接，构成肘部主要的铰链。肱三头肌拉动尺骨上端的鹰嘴，使肘伸直 [S30, S33]。

summary.en: Support the palm and fingers as a linked group.

detail.en: The wrist, palm and fingers contain many small bones linked by joints. These connections let the hand change shape for holding and gripping. One hand has 27 bones, although its bones are selected as one group in this whole-body view [S30].
detail.zh: 腕部、手掌和手指由许多小骨经关节连接而成。这些连接让手改变形状，完成握持等动作。一只手有27块骨，全身视图把它们合为一个可选组 [S30]。

summary.en: Support the palm and fingers as a linked group.

detail.en: The wrist, palm and fingers contain many small bones linked by joints. These connections let the hand change shape for holding and gripping. One hand has 27 bones, although its bones are selected as one group in this whole-body view [S30].
detail.zh: 腕部、手掌和手指由许多小骨经关节连接而成。这些连接让手改变形状，完成握持等动作。一只手有27块骨，全身视图把它们合为一个可选组 [S30]。

summary.en: Transfers weight and holds the hip socket.
summary.zh: 传递负重，并构成髋关节窝。

detail.en: Each hip bone forms one side of the pelvis and contains the hip socket. The socket receives the rounded head of the femur and helps pass weight into the leg. In an adult, three growing bones have fused into this one hip bone [S30].
detail.zh: 每块髋骨构成骨盆的一侧，并带有髋臼。髋臼容纳圆形的股骨头，把重量传入下肢。成人的一块髋骨由生长时的三部分融合而成 [S30]。

summary.en: Transfers weight and holds the hip socket.
summary.zh: 传递负重，并构成髋关节窝。

detail.en: Each hip bone forms one side of the pelvis and contains the hip socket. The socket receives the rounded head of the femur and helps pass weight into the leg. In an adult, three growing bones have fused into this one hip bone [S30].
detail.zh: 每块髋骨构成骨盆的一侧，并带有髋臼。髋臼容纳圆形的股骨头，把重量传入下肢。成人的一块髋骨由生长时的三部分融合而成 [S30]。

summary.en: Carries load along the thigh.

detail.en: The femur is the long bone in the thigh. Its rounded upper end fits into the hip socket, while its lower end meets the shin bone at the knee. It carries weight and acts as a lever when leg muscles pull [S30].
detail.zh: 股骨是大腿里的长骨。上端的圆头嵌在髋臼内，下端与胫骨在膝部相接。它既承重，也在肌肉拉动时充当杠杆 [S30]。

summary.en: Carries load along the thigh.

detail.en: The femur is the long bone in the thigh. Its rounded upper end fits into the hip socket, while its lower end meets the shin bone at the knee. It carries weight and acts as a lever when leg muscles pull [S30].
detail.zh: 股骨是大腿里的长骨。上端的圆头嵌在髋臼内，下端与胫骨在膝部相接。它既承重，也在肌肉拉动时充当杠杆 [S30]。

summary.en: Redirects the front thigh tendon at the knee.
summary.zh: 在膝前改变大腿前侧肌腱的走向。

detail.en: The patella is the kneecap at the front of the knee. It sits within the tendon of the front thigh muscles and changes the tendon’s path. This helps those muscles pull to straighten the knee [S30].
detail.zh: 髌骨位于膝前，嵌在大腿前侧肌肉的肌腱中。它改变肌腱经过膝部的走向。这样有助于这些肌肉拉动小腿、伸直膝关节 [S30]。

summary.en: Redirects the front thigh tendon at the knee.
summary.zh: 在膝前改变大腿前侧肌腱的走向。

detail.en: The patella is the kneecap at the front of the knee. It sits within the tendon of the front thigh muscles and changes the tendon’s path. This helps those muscles pull to straighten the knee [S30].
detail.zh: 髌骨位于膝前，嵌在大腿前侧肌肉的肌腱中。它改变肌腱经过膝部的走向。这样有助于这些肌肉拉动小腿、伸直膝关节 [S30]。

summary.en: Carries most lower-leg weight towards the ankle.
summary.zh: 把小腿大部分负重传向踝部。

detail.en: The tibia is the larger of the two lower-leg bones. It receives weight from the femur at the knee and carries most of the lower leg’s load towards the ankle. Its front edge forms the shin [S30].
detail.zh: 胫骨是小腿两块骨中较粗的一块。它在膝部承接股骨传来的重量，把小腿的大部分负重传向踝部。小腿前方的骨性边缘就是胫骨的一部分 [S30]。

summary.en: Carries most lower-leg weight towards the ankle.
summary.zh: 把小腿大部分负重传向踝部。

detail.en: The tibia is the larger of the two lower-leg bones. It receives weight from the femur at the knee and carries most of the lower leg’s load towards the ankle. Its front edge forms the shin [S30].
detail.zh: 胫骨是小腿两块骨中较粗的一块。它在膝部承接股骨传来的重量，把小腿的大部分负重传向踝部。小腿前方的骨性边缘就是胫骨的一部分 [S30]。

summary.en: Supports the outer side of the ankle.

detail.en: The fibula is the slender bone on the outer side of the lower leg. Its lower end helps form the outer ankle and supports that joint. It does not carry the same large share of body weight as the tibia [S30].
detail.zh: 腓骨是小腿外侧较细的骨。它的下端构成外踝，帮助稳定踝关节。它承担的体重不像胫骨那样多 [S30]。

summary.en: Supports the outer side of the ankle.

detail.en: The fibula is the slender bone on the outer side of the lower leg. Its lower end helps form the outer ankle and supports that joint. It does not carry the same large share of body weight as the tibia [S30].
detail.zh: 腓骨是小腿外侧较细的骨。它的下端构成外踝，帮助稳定踝关节。它承担的体重不像胫骨那样多 [S30]。

summary.en: Share load through the heel, arches and toes.
summary.zh: 经足跟、足弓和足趾分担负重。

detail.en: The foot bones spread load through the heel, arches and toes. Their joints also allow the foot to adjust as you stand and walk. A foot usually has 26 bones, with small extra sesamoid bones counted separately; this view groups them for selection [S30].
detail.zh: 足骨经足跟、足弓和足趾分担负重。骨之间的关节让脚在站立和行走时作出调整。一只脚通常有26块骨，小的籽骨另计；这里把足骨合为一组 [S30]。

summary.en: Share load through the heel, arches and toes.
summary.zh: 经足跟、足弓和足趾分担负重。

detail.en: The foot bones spread load through the heel, arches and toes. Their joints also allow the foot to adjust as you stand and walk. A foot usually has 26 bones, with small extra sesamoid bones counted separately; this view groups them for selection [S30].
detail.zh: 足骨经足跟、足弓和足趾分担负重。骨之间的关节让脚在站立和行走时作出调整。一只脚通常有26块骨，小的籽骨另计；这里把足骨合为一组 [S30]。

summary.en: Meets neighbouring wrist bones.

detail.en: The scaphoid is a small wrist bone near the thumb side. It meets neighbouring wrist bones, including the lunate, across smooth joint surfaces. This close-up moves the left wrist bones beside the body so you can compare their shapes [S30].
detail.zh: 舟骨是腕部靠拇指一侧的小骨。它通过光滑的关节面与月骨等相邻腕骨相接。近景把左腕的小骨移到身体旁，方便比较形状 [S30]。

summary.en: Shares the curved wrist contact region.

detail.en: The lunate is a small wrist bone beside the scaphoid. Their neighbouring surfaces can glide by small amounts as the wrist moves. The name describes its curved, moon-like shape [S30].
detail.zh: 月骨是舟骨旁的一块腕骨。手腕活动时，它们相对的骨面能作小幅滑动。月骨的名字与它弯曲、像月牙的外形有关 [S30]。

summary.en: Sits centrally among the wrist bones.

detail.en: The capitate lies near the centre of the wrist bones. It helps link the wrist to the palm through its connections with neighbouring bones. Compare its rounded upper part with the smaller scaphoid and lunate beside it [S30].
detail.zh: 头状骨位于腕骨中央附近。它通过与相邻骨的连接，参与把腕部与手掌连起来。可以比较它圆形的上端和旁边较小的舟骨、月骨 [S30]。

summary.en: Forms the palm side of the index knuckle.
summary.zh: 构成食指指根靠手掌的一侧。

detail.en: This metacarpal lies in the palm below the index finger. Its rounded head meets the first finger bone at the knuckle. Their joint allows bending and straightening as well as some sideways movement [S30].
detail.zh: 第二掌骨位于手掌内，接在食指下方。它的圆形骨头与食指近节指骨在指根相接。这个关节既能屈伸，也能作一定程度的侧向活动 [S30]。

summary.en: Moves on the index metacarpal head.

detail.en: This is the first finger bone beyond the index knuckle. Its base rests against the rounded head of the index metacarpal. It moves there when you bend the finger or spread it sideways [S30].
detail.zh: 食指近节指骨是食指越过指根后的第一块骨。它的基部与第二掌骨圆形的骨头相接。弯曲食指或向侧面张开时，它就在这个关节处活动 [S30]。

summary.en: Provides the base surface for the thumb.
summary.zh: 为拇指基部提供关节面。

detail.en: The trapezium is a wrist bone at the base of the thumb. Its surface fits the thumb metacarpal like two matching saddles. This shape allows movement in two main directions at the thumb base [S30].
detail.zh: 大多角骨是位于拇指基部的腕骨。它与第一掌骨的关节面像两个凹凸相配的鞍面。这种形状让拇指根部能沿两个主要方向活动 [S30]。

summary.en: Moves over the trapezium at the thumb base.
summary.zh: 在拇指基部的大多角骨上活动。

detail.en: The thumb metacarpal connects the wrist to the thumb. At its base, it meets the trapezium in a saddle-shaped joint. Movement here helps bring the thumb across the palm towards the fingers [S30].
detail.zh: 第一掌骨连接腕部与拇指。它在基部与大多角骨形成鞍状关节。这里的活动帮助拇指越过手掌，靠向其他手指 [S30]。

summary.en: Covers one side of the joint contact.

detail.en: Articular cartilage is the smooth covering on this upper bone end. It helps the facing surfaces move with little friction. The blue-grey cap follows the bone’s curve; the opening is enlarged to show the layers [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 关节软骨覆盖在这块上方骨的末端，表面光滑。它帮助相对的骨面顺畅活动。蓝灰色软骨帽贴着骨端的曲面，模型放宽了开口以显示层次 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Covers the opposing joint contact.
summary.zh: 覆盖相对的关节接触面。

detail.en: This cartilage covers the lower bone’s facing surface. It meets the opposite cartilage across a thin fluid-filled space, rather than joining the bones into one solid piece. The cap is made easier to see in this teaching model [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 这层软骨覆盖下方骨相对的关节面。两侧软骨之间留有含滑液的薄隙，并没有把两块骨连成一个实心整体。教学模型把软骨帽画得较明显 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Encloses and lubricates the joint cavity.
summary.zh: 围住关节腔，滑液润滑相对表面。

detail.en: The joint capsule forms a sleeve around the space between the bone ends. Its inner lining makes synovial fluid, which helps the cartilage surfaces move smoothly. A cut-open wall and blue-green fluid show what is normally hidden inside [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 关节囊像套筒一样围住骨端之间的空间。内层滑膜产生滑液，帮助软骨面顺畅活动。模型切开囊壁，用蓝绿色表示滑液，让内部结构可见 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Connect bone to bone across the joint.

detail.en: Ligaments are strong bands that connect bone to bone. These bands cross the outside of the joint capsule and help limit excess movement. Unlike muscles, they do not shorten to pull the joint into motion [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 韧带是连接骨与骨的坚韧带状组织。图中的带子跨过关节囊外侧，帮助限制过度活动。韧带不像肌肉那样主动缩短、拉动关节 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Forms the dense outer wall of the specimen.

detail.en: Compact bone makes the dense, hard wall around a long bone’s shaft. The cut face shows that this wall has thickness, with marrow space inside it. A thin outer covering, the periosteum, is shown peeled back beside the opening [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 骨密质构成长骨骨干致密而坚硬的外壁。切面显示骨壁有一定厚度，内侧是容纳骨髓的空间。开口旁翻起的薄层表示骨膜 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Supports the ends with a hard branching framework.
summary.zh: 以坚硬分支网架支撑骨端。

detail.en: Spongy bone is a network of hard struts with spaces between them. The connected struts help support the wide ends of this long bone. They are enlarged here so you can distinguish the bone from the soft marrow in its spaces [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 骨松质由坚硬的骨小梁连成网架，网架之间留有空隙。相连的小梁帮助支撑长骨较宽的两端。模型放大了网架，方便分清硬骨与空隙内柔软的骨髓 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Occupies spaces inside the bone.

detail.en: Marrow is soft tissue inside bones. Red marrow makes blood cells, while yellow marrow contains much fat. This section shows red marrow among the end struts and yellow marrow in the shaft; the pattern varies with age and with the bone [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 骨髓是骨内部的软组织。红骨髓制造血细胞，黄骨髓含有较多脂肪。这个截面在骨端网架之间显示红骨髓，在骨干髓腔显示黄骨髓；分布随年龄和骨而不同 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Carries blood into the living bone.

detail.en: Bone contains living cells that need a blood supply. A nutrient artery enters through the hard wall and branches towards the tissues inside. The enlarged red branches show a route for blood, rather than an empty hole through the bone [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 骨含有活细胞，需要血液供应。滋养动脉穿过坚硬的骨壁，向内部组织分支。放大的红色分支表示血液通路，并不是贯穿骨的空洞 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Shows the early gap and clot.

detail.en: A fracture breaks the hard bone and can tear nearby blood vessels. Blood collects and clots around the break, shown here in dark red. This is the first specimen in the repair row, with a gap still visible between the broken ends [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 骨折会破坏硬骨，也可能撕裂附近的血管。血液在断处聚集并凝固，图中用暗红色表示。这是修复列的第一个标本，断端之间仍可见裂隙 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Shows a soft bridge around the break.
summary.zh: 显示断处周围的软性桥接。

detail.en: A soft callus can form a bridge around the broken ends. It contains tissues that are softer than mature bone, helping join the damaged region. The blue-grey bridge marks this stage, rather than a second blood clot [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 较软的骨痂可在断端周围形成桥接。其中的组织比成熟骨软，帮助连接损伤区域。蓝灰色桥接表示软骨痂阶段，与前一标本的血肿不同 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Shows a hard bony bridge.

detail.en: New bony tissue replaces the softer bridge, forming a hard callus. The enlarged, rough bridge around the break is now bone. This specimen shows a stage of repair, without setting a number of days for healing [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 新的骨组织替代较软的桥接，形成硬骨痂。断处周围较粗大的桥接此时已是骨。标本表示修复的一个阶段，没有规定愈合天数 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Shows the reshaped bone outline.
summary.zh: 显示重新塑形的骨外形。

detail.en: The repaired bone can gradually reshape through remodelling. Extra callus is reduced and the shaft becomes smoother, though a slight bulge may remain. Read the four specimens from left to right as a process, not as equal lengths of time [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 修复后的骨可继续通过重塑调整外形。多余骨痂减少，骨干逐渐平滑，但仍可能留有轻微隆起。从左到右观察四个标本，表示的是过程顺序，不是相等的时间段 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Marks a growing bone’s cartilage region.
summary.zh: 标示生长中骨的软骨区域。

detail.en: A growth plate is a region of cartilage near the end of a young long bone. New bone replaces cartilage as the bone lengthens. This band belongs to the growing-bone model, not the adult skeleton beside it [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 生长板位于幼年长骨靠近骨端的区域，由软骨构成。骨增长时，新骨逐步替代软骨。这条带只属于生长标本，不属于旁边的成人骨架 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Marks a surface being renewed.
summary.zh: 标示正在更新的骨表面。

detail.en: Bone tissue continues to change after height growth stops. During remodelling, old tissue is removed and new tissue forms. The marked patch shows the idea of local renewal, not the speed of a person’s bone growth [S30, S34].
detail.zh: 身高停止增长后，骨组织仍会更新。重塑时，旧组织被去除，新组织形成。标出的区域只说明局部更新的概念，不表示某个人骨生长的速度 [S30, S34]。

summary.en: Pulls the radius to help bend the elbow.

detail.en: The biceps is at the front of the upper arm. Its tendon carries a pull across the elbow to the radius, helping bend the elbow. It can also help turn the palm upwards [S30, S32].
detail.zh: 肱二头肌位于上臂前侧。肌腱把它的拉力跨过肘部传到桡骨，帮助屈肘。它也帮助前臂转动，使手掌向上 [S30, S32]。

summary.en: Pulls the ulna to help straighten the elbow.

detail.en: The triceps lies at the back of the upper arm. Its tendon pulls on the upper end of the ulna to straighten the elbow. It produces the opposite elbow action to the biceps, although both muscles can help steady the joint [S30, S33].
detail.zh: 肱三头肌位于上臂后侧。它的肌腱拉动尺骨上端，使肘伸直。它与肱二头肌在肘部的主要动作相反，两者也能共同帮助稳定关节 [S30, S33]。

summary.en: Transmits a pull towards the radius.

detail.en: This tendon carries the biceps muscle’s pull to the radius. Because the pull crosses the elbow, it can help turn the forearm at that joint. Only a short, enlarged tendon segment is drawn here [S30, S32, S34].
detail.zh: 这段肌腱把肱二头肌的拉力传到桡骨。拉力跨过肘部，因此能帮助前臂在肘关节处转动。模型只画出一小段放大的肌腱 [S30, S32, S34]。

summary.en: Transmits a pull towards the ulna.

detail.en: This tendon carries the triceps muscle’s pull to the ulna at the point of the elbow. The pull helps straighten the elbow. The short tendon segment is enlarged so its connection is easier to see [S30, S33, S34].
detail.zh: 这段肌腱把肱三头肌的拉力传到肘尖处的尺骨鹰嘴。这个拉力帮助肘伸直。模型把一小段肌腱放大，方便观察连接位置 [S30, S33, S34]。

summary.en: Carries the load around a fixed pivot.

detail.en: The beam turns around the fixed hinge, which marks the pivot. In this ideal model, the beam is 0.30 m long and the dot marks a pull point 0.04 m from the pivot. Place the same load at 0.15 m or 0.30 m and compare the pull needed to balance it. The model leaves out the beam’s weight and uses a pull at right angles to the beam, so it does not show the real biceps’ direction of pull [S34].
detail.zh: 这根梁绕固定铰链转动，铰链就是支点。理想模型中的梁长0.30 m，小圆点标出距支点0.04 m的拉力作用处。把同样的负载放在距支点0.15 m或0.30 m处，比较平衡它所需的拉力。模型忽略梁自身的重量，拉力与梁垂直，不表示真实肱二头肌的拉力方向 [S34]。

summary.en: Applies a vertical downward force.

detail.en: The block marks where an outside force pulls vertically down on the beam. Choose its force in newtons and compare two distances from the pivot. Zero removes the external load, while a real arm would still have other forces acting on it. The block’s size does not measure its force or your muscle strength [S34].
detail.zh: 方块标出外加力竖直向下作用在梁上的位置。可以选择以牛顿表示的力，并比较两种支点距离。零表示没有外加负载，真实手臂上仍会有其他力。方块大小不表示力的大小，也不测量你的肌力 [S34]。

summary.en: Locates the skeleton within the adult reference body.
summary.zh: 在成人参考身体中定位骨架。

detail.en: The faint body surface helps locate the bones inside an adult body. It can be hidden to make the skeleton easier to inspect. This reference body is not a prediction of a child’s body shape [S30].
detail.zh: 淡显的体表帮助定位成人身体内的骨。隐藏体表后，骨架更容易看清。这个参考身体不用于预测儿童的体形 [S30]。

summary.en: Marks the fixed centre of rotation.

detail.en: The fixed hinge marks the pivot of the ideal lever. The beam rotates around it [S34].
detail.zh: 固定铰链标出理想杠杆的支点，梁绕它转动 [S34]。

label.zh: 由竖直向下转过的角度
